answer: The dye vats stand in the back room, indigo dark as midnight in the pots. Proof of batik dyer via indigo cloth tally — a cloth the dyer dips only after 29 cloths hold their dye without one bleeding at the edge, each dipped by the dyer herself. crystal draws the wax lines with the canting, steady as a hand can hold. quartz dips the cloth slow and lifts it out to oxidise in the air. relic boils the wax away and rinses the cloth till the water runs clear. Twenty-nine cloths must hold their dye without one bleeding at the edge, and the next still bleeds where the wax ran thin.
